deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematics on this folio. It is a printed page, numbered 15, from a German antiquarian bookseller's sale catalogue. The running head reads 'Astronomie'. The previous and next pages are pp. 14 and 16 of the same catalogue, and p. 16 ends with the printer's line 'Druck von C. Schünemann'. The page has three blocks:

1. The end of the 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik' section: Withering through Zoologe.
2. An unheaded section on gardening and horticulture (Gartenbau): Blotz, Blumenzeitung, Borchmeyer, Bosse, Bouché, Christ, Diecker, Dietrich, Gartenbeobachter, Hamburger Garten- und Blumenzeitung, Korth, Krottendorff, Krause, Lüder, Poscharsky, Reichart, Reider, Richter, Ritter, Schmidt, Schoch, Waller, Wredow, Zetter.
3. The start of the 'Astronomie' section: Airy (tr. Littrow), Annalen der Sternwarte München (Lamont), Annuaire du Bureau des longitudes, and Apelt.

Each entry gives author, short title, format, place, year (with the century dropped, e.g. 839 = 1839), binding, original price in parentheses, and sale price in Thaler and Silbergroschen.

There is no handwriting, no annotation and no derivation, so nothing can be reconstructed mathematically. The latest imprints are 1859 on this page and 1860 on the next (Ohm). The catalogue therefore dates from about 1860 or later. It is probably wastepaper or a wrapper kept with the papers, not a working sheet from 1853.
deep.surprise_reason: The folio is a printed antiquarian book catalogue page (gardening and astronomy listings) with no mathematical content and no visible annotation by Riemann.
transcription_corrections: The page number printed in the header is 15, not 45. This is consistent with the neighbouring pages 14 and 16.
The middle block (Blotz to Zetter) is a gardening/horticulture section whose heading is not on this page; it is not part of 'Astronomie'.
The currency sign transcribed as ₰ (Pfennig) is in fact the Thaler sign, as the next page's 'Thlr.' confirms.
The Airy entry is printed 'G. C.' in the catalogue; the correct initials for George Biddell Airy are 'G. B.'.
Years are abbreviated by dropping the century (e.g. '839' = 1839, '700' = 1700). The Annuaire entry gives full years (1813, 1827/29, 1830, 1833, 1838).
